method: Four complete pinned files read and Git blobs verified. Original duplicate detector/handler AST-extracted with synthetic in-memory source entries, suppressed terminal and apply_changesFalse; noAPT module/system configuration execution.
findings: get_duplicates keys each entry separately by component, normalized URI/dist and source type, but handle_duplicates disables whole source entry. Source entries with extra distinct components are not merged/split before disabling.

Synthetic3entries main;main+universe;universe produce disabled flagsFalse,True,True and lose universe entirely. Precomputed overlap groups can choose an already-disabled entry as representative. Original-function control confirmed in-memory loss; no system files saved.

Configured equivalent schemes default groups http/https/ftp; exact URI bytes/protocol distinction is intentionally collapsed. Path normpath changes syntactic identity; this is APT-entry equivalence, not file-content proof.
Dry-run apply_changesFalse suppresses save but still mutates in-memory disabled flags and prints disabled wording. main skips empty-file handling for dry-run; persistence was not executed.
Summary counts number of overlapping component groups, not unique newly disabled entries. Same entry may occur in multiple groups.
get_empty_files groups only filenames represented by source entries; truly empty files absent from parsed source list may not be visible. ActualAPT parser contract unqualified.
samefile helper returnsFalse on filesystem error, losing distinction between different identity and unknown identity; no caller safety conclusion until usage reviewed.

result.scope: Original duplicate-detection/handler functions with synthetic in-memory source entries and suppressed terminal output; apply_changesFalse, noAPT imports or system files read/written.

limits: APT/Linux parser,fullCLI,source save/removal,upstream suite not executed. No productioncode copied or system configuration touched.
